method_observation.observation: Marine-insurance probing produced many high-value institution and mechanism categories, but recall quality degraded sharply when moving from actor/mechanism names into exact policy wording, thresholds or version chronology. Insurance vocabulary is useful as source-discovery scaffolding; exact clause semantics should remain Evidence-first later.

proposed_validation_probe.reason: The legacy atlas verification explicitly identified naval-architecture suppliers as under-recalled, and P003's remaining negative space broadens that into ship design, machinery/equipment and repair/conversion services. This is a first-order industrial topology gap still suitable for atlas_only blind Memory without crossing into Evidence.

stop_reason: The preset marine-insurance mechanism and institution questions were answered. Marginal recall then shifted into exact clause wording, version chronology, market-share ranking and jurisdiction-specific legal tests that require later claim-scoped Evidence, so the pass stopped rather than manufacturing legal precision.
